projects.title: No Code EDA
bulletPoints: Built a full stack AI analytics web app to explore datasets up to 25 GB and create charts in plain English.
Designed REST APIs in FastAPI that let the React front end run data analysis workflows on demand.
Scaled to concurrent users by containerizing each workspace with Docker in an isolated, reproducible environment.
Redesigned the data analysis workflow with AI assisted human computer interaction (HCI) principles, letting users sort, filter, reorder, and visualize datasets through natural language.
Integrated the Meridian package (UCSD developer package) to data bind CSV data with visualizations.

projects.title: Ecommerce Dashboard
bulletPoints: Shipped a React/TypeScript dashboard with NextAuth login, deployed on Vercel.
Synced per user data across devices via Firestore (NoSQL), using debounced writes to cut redundant saves.
Brought spreadsheet style workflows to a mobile first experience, with product, order, and reporting views tailored for small business style operations.

projects.title: DeckScan & Wash Shuffle Research
bulletPoints: Tripled data collection efficiency with a web app that reads deck orderings from photos (with Prof. Peter Chi).
Connected Next.js image capture to a Python batch inference backend with CSV export across 600+ trials.
Generated large scale datasets from wash shuffle trials for probabilistic modeling and statistical analysis.

projects.title: Signal Normalizer
bulletPoints: Halved manual preprocessing time with a full stack web app that automates fluorescence signal processing.
Built a React upload and review front end backed by a Node.js service that runs Python normalization jobs.
Python pipelines with pandas and openpyxl normalize uploaded datasets for consistent scaling, with structured tables ready for direct import into GraphPad Prism.

projects.title: CrunchyRoll Award Data Analysis
bulletPoints: Collected, cleaned, and wrangled multiple data frames from award and viewership sources.
Analyzed relationships between total views, genre, manga sales, and related factors.
Built a predictive model with data visualization to summarize patterns in the dataset.
